text.en:
The operation and effect of sections three and four of Commonwealth Act Numbered Five
hundred and sixty-seven are suspended for the year beginning July first, nineteen hundred an d thirty-nine,
and ending June thirty, nineteen hundred and forty, insofar as they affect owners or persons in control of sugar
lands ceded to others under contracts of lease or otherwise.

- This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 19, 1940.
